standard_prerequisites.name: Equality of structures through univalence
standard_prerequisites.statement: By univalence an equality of extensional well-founded relations reduces to an equivalence of the underlying structures, so the type is a set as soon as every automorphism is the identity.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the reduction performed at the start of the proof.

standard_prerequisites.name: Extensionality of the relation
standard_prerequisites.statement: Two elements of an extensional well-founded relation are equal as soon as they have the same predecessors.
standard_prerequisites.use: It turns the goal for one element into a pointwise comparison of the predecessor conditions.

standard_prerequisites.name: Induction on an accessible element
standard_prerequisites.statement: To prove a family over a well-founded relation it suffices to prove it for an element assuming it for all strictly smaller elements.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the induction on the relation that the proof performs.

core_obligations: Reduce the goal by univalence to showing that every automorphism of an extensional well-founded relation is the identity (source line 1076).
Prove by induction on the relation that the automorphism fixes every element, with the inductive hypothesis that it fixes all strictly smaller elements (source lines 1078-1079).

Use extensionality to reduce the goal at an element to the pointwise equivalence of the predecessor conditions, and use the automorphism property to replace the automorphism applied to the smaller element by the element itself (source lines 1081-1083).

Close both directions of that equivalence: one uses the inductive hypothesis on the smaller element, the other applies the inverse automorphism and the inductive hypothesis again (source lines 1084-1086).

proof_roadmap.step: Univalence reduction and induction on the relation.
Extensionality reduces the goal to a comparison of predecessor conditions.
Both directions of the comparison, with the inverse automorphism in the second.

difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the unlabelled author thm environment at source lines 1072-1074: the type of extensional well-founded relations is a set. The proof (source lines 1075-1087) is a full argument that is invisible in the statement: it reduces the goal by univalence to the triviality of all automorphisms, then inducts on the relation, uses extensionality to replace the goal at an element by the equivalence of the two predecessor conditions, and proves both directions of that equivalence, the first from the inductive hypothesis and the second through the inverse automorphism and the inductive hypothesis again. The reduction, the induction and the two directions are the substance.
